name: unswallow-monorepo
description: Monorepo for unswallow — detect and recover tool calls trapped inside a model's reasoning channel.

scripts.coverage: npm run build --workspace unswallow && node --import tsx --experimental-test-coverage --test packages/unswallow/test/*.test.ts
scripts.bench:fp: npm run build --workspace unswallow && node packages/bench/fp-eval.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace unswallow && node --import tsx --test packages/unswallow/test/semver.test.ts packages/unswallow/test/core.test.ts packages/unswallow/test/fp-guard.test.ts packages/unswallow/test/stream.test.ts packages/unswallow/test/stream-sweep.test.ts packages/unswallow/test/torture.test.ts packages/unswallow/test/history.test.ts packages/unswallow/test/proxy.test.ts packages/unswallow/test/otel.test.ts
scripts.bench: npm run build --workspace unswallow && node packages/bench/run.mjs
scripts.bench:check: npm run build --workspace unswallow && node packages/bench/run.mjs --check
scripts.bench:update: npm run build --workspace unswallow && node packages/bench/run.mjs --update-pins
scripts.bench:perf: npm run build --workspace unswallow && node --expose-gc packages/bench/perf.mjs
